author: Michael Larabel
description: Synex is a Linux distribution that's been around for some months as a Debian-based, minimalistic Linux distribution out of Argentina focused on the needs of small and medium businesses. Making it a bit more intriguing for some now is that with their new release based on Debian 13 is a server edition and they have added native OpenZFS file-system support for new installations...
title: Synex Server: A New Debian Based Linux Distro With Native ZFS Installation Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: On Friday AMD sent out another set of AMDGPU kernel graphics driver and AMDKFD kernel compute driver patches for queuing in DRM-Next ahead of the upcoming Linux 6.20~7.0 kernel cycle kicking off in February...
title: Important AMDGPU & AMDKFD Driver Improvements Readied For Linux 6.20~7.0

author: Michael Larabel
description: FreeBSD 15.0 had been aiming to offer a KDE desktop installation option as part of the FreeBSD OS installer. This initiative as part of the FreeBSD laptop support enhancements project didn't pan out in time for FreeBSD 15.0 but now they are working on getting the installer option ready for FreeBSD 15.1. Adding a NVIDIA GPU driver option to the FreeBSD installer was also recently carried out...
title: FreeBSD 15.1 Aims To Have KDE Desktop Installer Option

author: Michael Larabel
description: CVE-2026-0915 was published on Friday as a security issue with the GNU C Library "glibc" for code introduced 30 years ago. The latest Glibc Git code is now patched for this issue introduced in 1996...
title: CVE-2026-0915: GNU C Library Fixes A Security Issue Present Since 1996

author: Michael Larabel
description: KDE developers have been quite busy this week in preparing for the upcoming Plasma 6.6 release in February while also beginning to land features for what will be the Plasma 6.7 desktop...
title: KDE Begins Landing Features For Plasma 6.7, Some Last Minute Plasma 6.6 Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Shotcut 26.1 beta was released overnight as the newest version of this Qt6-based, cross-platform video editing solution. Standing out the most with this new development release are some new GPU-accelerated hardware decode options for aiming to help speed-up this free software video editor...
title: Shotcut 26.1 Beta Video Editor Adds New Hardware Decoder Options

author: Michael Larabel
description: As part of the GNOME Foundation funded Digital Wellbeing project, the GNOME Shell for GNOME 50 has merged options to prevent unlocking the desktop session past their bed time. The intent here is on rounding out GNOME's parental controls functionality...
title: GNOME 50 Will Make Sure You Don't Use Your Computer Past Your Bedtime
